concepts.definition: ACNC charity registration status as published in the AIS (e.g. Registered, Voluntarily Revoked Not Entitled To Be A Charity, Revoked Double Defaulter). An administrative registration state, not a legal form or trading status.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.status is a coarse enum (active/deregistered/in_liquidation/suspended/unknown) and ext.entity.status_detail is defined as a registrar company status code+label; neither can carry the ACNC's charity-specific revocation wording without changing meaning or owner.

concepts.definition: ACNC charity size classification (Small, Medium, Large) as published for the reporting year. An administrative size band, not a revenue figure.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.revenue_band is a revenue/turnover band from a named scheme and would misrepresent an ACNC size classification as a financial measure; no existing concept holds charity size.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity self-identifies as a basic religious charity in its AIS (y/n). A regulatory category, not a statement of religious activity.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept captures this ACNC regulatory category; ext.entity.tax_concession covers PBI/HPC/DGR only and would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity reports being an incorporated association (y/n) in the AIS. A self-reported indicator, not a legal-form determination.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.legal_form is a registrar-decoded company type; using it here would assert a legal form the source does not state, and no existing concept holds this AIS indicator.

concepts.definition: State or territory incorporated-association registration number as published, one observation per state. The state is carried in the scheme qualifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.prior_registration_number is a single legacy state registration number for a national registrar transition; these are current state association numbers across up to eight jurisdictions and need a scheme qualifier to distinguish them.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity reports fundraising activity in a given jurisdiction or channel (y/n). The jurisdiction or channel is carried in the scheme qualifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.operating_region describes where the business operates, not whether it fundraises there; no existing concept holds fundraising activity indicators.

concepts.definition: Fundraising licence or registration number issued by a state or territory regulator, as published. The jurisdiction is carried in the scheme qualifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.licence.number is owned by the licence entity type and identifies a licence held by a business; these are charity fundraising registrations reported in the AIS and would need a licence role and issuer that the source does not state.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity reports having conducted activities during the reporting period (y/n).
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept records whether the entity was active in the period; entity.status is a coarse registration state and would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Free-text explanation the charity gives for not conducting activities in the reporting period.
source_paths: why charity did not conduct activities
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds a narrative reason for inactivity; ext.entity.status_detail is a registrar code+label.

concepts.definition: Free-text description of how the charity pursued its purposes during the reporting period, in the charity's own words.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a short source-stated tag with a scheme qualifier; this is a long narrative activity description and would lose meaning if stored as a tag.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity reports a given kind of international activity (operating overseas including programs, transferring goods or services overseas, other). The kind is carried in the scheme qualifier.
source_paths: international activities undertaken - operating overseas including programs
international activities undertaken - transferring goods or services overseas
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.operating_country records a country, not an activity indicator; no existing concept holds these AIS international-activity flags.

concepts.definition: Free-text description of the charity's international activities, in the charity's own words. The scheme qualifier records which publisher field the text came from (international_activities_details vs other_international_activities_description).
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds narrative international-activity text; ext.entity.operating_country is a country value only. Two distinct publisher fields feed this concept, so a scheme qualifier is needed to preserve provenance.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity reports having reportable related party transactions in the period (y/n).
source_paths: charity has reportable related party transactions
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept covers related-party transaction reporting; it is not a financial amount and not a licence condition.

concepts.definition: One type of related party transaction the charity reports (e.g. fees paid to a related party for goods or services, loans from/to a related party), split from the publisher's semicolon list.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds related-party transaction categories; the field is a list of transaction kinds, not a financial amount or licence condition.

concepts.definition: Free-text detail the charity gives about related party transactions or other relevant matters, in the charity's own words. The scheme qualifier records which publisher field the text came from (other_details vs other_relevant_details).
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds narrative related-party disclosure text. Two distinct publisher fields feed this concept, so a scheme qualifier is needed to preserve provenance.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity reports key management personnel in its AIS (y/n).
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.responsible_persons is a board-size count from a different regulator; this is a yes/no AIS indicator and would change meaning if reused.

concepts.definition: Number of key management personnel the charity reports in its AIS.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.responsible_persons is the regulator's responsible-persons (board) count for a different scheme; reusing it would conflate two different populations.

concepts.definition: Total amount paid to key management personnel as reported in the AIS for the reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide; the period is the charity's financial reporting period.
source_paths: Total paid to Key Management Personnel
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income and other financial concepts cover income/tax measures, not KMP remuneration; a new money concept with currency and period qualifiers is required.

concepts.definition: Free-text description of the charity's assets and liabilities as reported in the AIS.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds narrative balance-sheet description; the financial concepts are numeric amounts.

concepts.definition: Accounting basis the charity reports for its AIS financial information (Cash or Accrual).
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept records the accounting basis of reported financials; it is a methodological qualifier, not a financial amount.

concepts.definition: Type of financial statement the charity reports (e.g. Special purpose financial statements, General purpose financial statements), in the publisher's wording.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept records the financial-statement type; it is a reporting classification, not a financial amount or licence attribute.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity's financial report is consolidated with more than one entity (y/n).
source_paths: report consolidated with more than one entity
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept records consolidation scope of a financial report.

concepts.definition: Whether the charity's financial report has a modification (y/n).
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept records audit/report modification status.

concepts.definition: Type of financial report modification reported (e.g. Qualified/qualification, Disclaimed/disclaimer), in the publisher's wording.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept records the kind of report modification; it is not a licence condition or entity status.

concepts.definition: Whether a cooperative financial report was submitted to the regulator (y/n), as reported in the AIS.
source_paths: coop financial report submitted to regulator
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept records this regulatory submission indicator.

concepts.definition: Date the Annual Information Statement was due to the ACNC. An administrative lodgement deadline, not an incorporation or licence date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds AIS lodgement deadlines; entity.date_registered and licence dates have different meanings.

concepts.definition: Date the ACNC received the Annual Information Statement. An administrative lodgement date, not an incorporation or licence date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds AIS receipt dates; observation.observed_at is when the source stated it, not the lodgement date.

concepts.definition: Date the ACNC received the charity's financial report. An administrative lodgement date, not an incorporation or licence date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds financial-report receipt dates; observation.observed_at is a different notion.

concepts.definition: Start date of the charity's financial reporting period covered by the AIS financial information.
concepts.why_not_existing: observation.valid_from is the validity of a claim, not the charity's financial reporting period; no existing concept holds the reporting period boundaries.

concepts.definition: End date of the charity's financial reporting period covered by the AIS financial information.
concepts.why_not_existing: observation.valid_to is the validity of a claim, not the charity's financial reporting period; no existing concept holds the reporting period boundaries.

concepts.definition: Number of full-time staff the charity reports for the reporting period.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds staff headcounts; ext.entity.responsible_persons is a board count.

concepts.definition: Number of part-time staff the charity reports for the reporting period.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds staff headcounts; ext.entity.responsible_persons is a board count.

concepts.definition: Number of casual staff the charity reports for the reporting period.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds staff headcounts; ext.entity.responsible_persons is a board count.

concepts.definition: Number of volunteers the charity reports for the reporting period.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds volunteer counts; ext.entity.responsible_persons is a board count.

concepts.definition: Total full-time-equivalent staff the charity reports for the reporting period.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds FTE staff counts; ext.entity.responsible_persons is a board count.

concepts.definition: Revenue from government as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income is a single total; no existing concept holds the AIS revenue breakdown by source.

concepts.definition: Donations and bequests revenue as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income is a single total; no existing concept holds the AIS revenue breakdown by source.

concepts.definition: Revenue from goods and services as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income is a single total; no existing concept holds the AIS revenue breakdown by source.

concepts.definition: Revenue from investments as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income is a single total; no existing concept holds the AIS revenue breakdown by source.

concepts.definition: All other revenue as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income is a single total; no existing concept holds the AIS revenue breakdown by source.

concepts.definition: Total revenue as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income is defined as total income for a period; the AIS distinguishes total revenue from total gross income and other income, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Other income as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds the AIS other-income line; ext.financial.total_income is a total.

concepts.definition: Total gross income as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income is a total income concept; the AIS reports total gross income as a distinct line from total revenue and other income, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Employee expenses as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds AIS expense lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Interest expenses as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds AIS expense lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Grants and donations made for use in Australia as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
source_paths: grants and donations made for use in Australia
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds grants made; a grant amount is an expense outflow, not business income.

concepts.definition: Grants and donations made for use outside Australia as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
source_paths: grants and donations made for use outside Australia
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds grants made; a grant amount is an expense outflow, not business income.

concepts.definition: All other expenses as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds AIS expense lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Total expenses as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds AIS expense totals; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Net surplus or deficit as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds the AIS net result; ext.financial.total_income is an income total, not a surplus.

concepts.definition: Other comprehensive income as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds other comprehensive income; ext.financial.total_income is a different measure.

concepts.definition: Total comprehensive income as reported in the AIS for the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds total comprehensive income; ext.financial.total_income is a different measure.

concepts.definition: Total current assets as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet asset lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Non-current loans receivable as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet asset lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Other non-current assets as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet asset lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Total non-current assets as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet asset lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Total assets as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet asset totals; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Total current liabilities as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet liability lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Non-current loans payable as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet liability lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Other non-current liabilities as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet liability lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Total non-current liabilities as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet liability lines; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Total liabilities as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds balance-sheet liability totals; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

concepts.definition: Net assets or liabilities as reported in the AIS at the end of the charity's reporting period. Currency is AUD as stated by the ACNC AIS guide.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds net assets; ext.financial concepts cover income and tax only.

reuse.entity.abn: The 'abn' column is an 11-digit Australian Business Number and is the sole stable key for the charity; entity.abn is the exact existing concept for this identifier.
reuse.entity.legal_name: The 'charity name' column is the name the charity is registered under with the ACNC; entity.legal_name is the registered-name concept and fits without asserting legal form.
reuse.ext.contact.website_domain: The 'charity website' column holds published website URLs; ext.contact.website_domain is the existing concept for a registrable published website host and fits after normalisation.
reuse.observation.source_id: Dataset-level provenance for every claim; the existing observation.source_id concept fits the ACNC AIS dataset identifier.
reuse.observation.source_record_id: Per-row provenance; the existing observation.source_record_id concept fits the deterministic content-hash record identifier used for this flat CSV.
reuse.observation.observed_at: Observation timestamp for each claim; the existing observation.observed_at concept fits the retrieval/observation time.
reuse.observation.ingested_at: Ingestion timestamp for each claim; the existing observation.ingested_at concept fits.
reuse.observation.licence: Dataset licence (CC-BY) from the metadata; the existing observation.licence concept fits.
reuse.observation.extractor_version: Mapping/extractor version for each claim; the existing observation.extractor_version concept fits.
